A '''voice enhancer''' was a component used in the [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] of the [[Ubese raider armor]]. The enhancer was located in the helmet's lower faceplate, alongside the [[Breath mask/Legends|breath filter]].<ref name="EGWT" />
